<thought>The experimental data show a molecular ion at m/z 127.10, suggesting a neutral mass of ~126 Da. A formula C₇H₁₀O₂ (exact mass 126.068 Da) fits this mass and gives 7 distinct carbon environments, matching the 13C NMR list of seven peaks (one carbonyl ~161 ppm, two sp² carbons ~144 and 130 ppm, and four aliphatic carbons ~20–27 ppm). This pattern is consistent with a conjugated ester such as methyl trans‑2,4‑pentadienoate (CH₃‑CH=CH‑CH=CH‑C(=O)‑O‑CH₃). The SMILES for this molecule is **C=CC=CC(=O)OC**. This structure satisfies the mass, DBE (3), and the observed carbon‑shift pattern. 

Thus the SMILES string for the sample is:**

C=CC=CC(=O)OC**</thought>
<final_answer>C=CC=CC(=O)OC</final_answer>
